run_doctest_calling_conventions: run the doctest module to verify cdecl, stdcall, and fastcall calling convention functions
test_cdecl_functions: test cdecl calling convention functions with zero to nine integer arguments
test_stdcall_functions: test stdcall calling convention functions with zero to nine integer arguments
test_fastcall_functions: test fastcall calling convention functions with zero to nine integer arguments
review_calling_conventions_test: review the Boost.Python test module for calling convention doctests
